comment: Atlas Vector Search index over the memories collection. Embeddings are Voyage vectors stored on each memory document in the `embedding` field (1024 dimensions, cosine similarity; voyage-3 is the default model and still needs Nathan's confirmation, a different model means a different index). The owner_salesperson_id and forgotten filter fields are what let a vector query be pre-filtered to one salesperson's unforgotten memories, so semantic search can never reach across owners or into forgotten items. Search indexes are created with createSearchIndex, not createIndex; scripts/apply-indexes.mjs applies this file too.
name: memories_vector
